page.overview:
Who is Gan Fall?

Gan Fall is the current God of Skypiea. A venerable figure who served in that role for decades, he was overthrown by Enel and cast out of power for six years. During his exile, he roamed the sky as a mercenary known as the Knight of the Sky.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Skypiea Arc.

Gan Fall is an elderly man of average height, distinguished by his long white hair, thick mustache, and pointed beard. True to his title as the Knight of the Sky, he dons a full suit of metal, medieval-style armor, complete with pauldrons, gauntlets, and greaves, but tends to keep his helmet’s visor raised. Under his armor, he wears a reddish pink shirt with a darker wavy pattern and brown trousers. A long, billowing cloak hangs from his shoulders, fastened with two rosette studs—dark brown on the outside and greenish yellow on the inner lining. Even though he is a Skypiean, he does not seem to have wings.

In his role as God of Skypiea in past, rather than his armored garb, Gan Fall donned an attire more fitting his station that consisted of robes in light green under a grand white and golden yellow mantle with a decorative red meander pattern.
